### Lunch

The lunches during the course will be provided at **Cafe Bryggan** located at the **IKDC** building which is a 10 minute walk from the course. The restaurant menu can be found [here](https://mersmak.me/vara-stallen/bryggan/).

### Dinner

The dinner will be at **Lundabryggeriets Ölkällare**, a local brewery and restaurant located in Lund. The address is Sankt Laurentiigatan 5 A, 222 21 Lund. The restaurant is a 10-15 minute walk from the course venue. The menu can be found [here](https://lundabryggeriet.se/olkallaren/). We will walk there together from the course venue at 17:00.

## Contact

This workshop is run by the **National Bioinformatics Infrastructure Sweden (NBIS)**. NBIS is a platform that is part of **SciLifeLab**.

If you would like to get in touch with us regarding this workshop, please [contact us](mailto:edu.plotting.r%40nbis.se).


If you would like to get in touch with us regarding the course at GitHub, kindly write to us at the [issues](https://github.com/NBISweden/workshop-data-visualization-r/issues) page.
